review_summary: The differential captures the major disease processes but under‑estimates the dominance of diabetic ESRD and omits several high‑severity findings (urine concentrating defect, hypoglycaemia risk, medication safety). Adjusted probabilities better reflect the evidence hierarchy. Adding explicit items for hypoglycaemia risk, medication safety, and confirming hypertension would improve completeness and clinical utility.
